milestone: R28 connection architecture audit / implemented decision record
objective: Refactor connection UX/backend from one shared Mode+country model into capability-driven provider modules, with provider-specific controls, metrics, refresh, sorting and testing.

localFindings.claim: Current UI exposes a shared Mode dropdown plus a global country setting even though providers have different capabilities.
Country targeting is currently valid only for NODE/CFON/CUSTOM; WARP/TOR/GOOL and bridge transports do not share the same country semantics.
Node Hub currently has list/import/filter/sort/metadata/history and fast endpoint tests, but no persisted per-node download/upload throughput columns.
Current Speed action is a direct-host ISP sample and intentionally bypasses FreeNet Hub browser proxies; it is not per-node throughput.
R27 already supports SS/VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Hysteria2 and multi-source public refresh with strict actual-exit country verification.

externalEvidence.finding: Node workspace; proxy pools; latency/speed testing; sort/filter; merge+dedupe; QR; export/conversion; tags/history/favorites; health monitor; Private Space.
Proxy list is separate from profile management; delay is shown per proxy; users can manually test and sort by test result.
Subscription architecture supports heterogeneous protocols; 2026 issue reports that unrestricted concurrent TCPing/real-delay tests can overload ISP/router/NAT and distort results.
Latency tests are explicit user/network actions through the selected proxy; separates delay testing from other availability tests.
Different outbound types are modeled explicitly; supports selector/urltest and protocol-specific outbounds.
Public nodes/subscriptions are refreshed periodically but availability varies by operator/region; public source says its page shows only a subset.

proposedArchitecture.principle: Provider capability model; UI renders only controls/tests a provider actually supports.
testPipeline: real proxy HTTP delay for survivors
bounded throughput sampling for top/visible/favorite candidates
proposedArchitecture.scheduling: Adaptive/background: cheap health frequently; source refresh by source TTL; throughput less frequently and bounded/concurrency-limited. Never full-throughput all nodes simultaneously.
proposedArchitecture.ui: Home + connection-method cards; clicking a provider opens provider-specific panel. Node Pool uses a sortable/filterable table with Country/Protocol/Status/Real Delay/Download/Upload/Stability/Last Test and actions.
proposedArchitecture.persistence: Keep provider/user config separate from dynamic candidate metrics; use indexed local store for candidate/test history; secrets protected separately.

proposedDoD: No global control is shown for a provider that cannot honor it.
Node list auto-refreshes and visibly marks freshness/stale results.
Quick Test All is bounded and fast; full throughput testing is controlled, cancellable and never floods all candidates at once.
Columns are sortable/filterable and preserve prior valid results across source refresh when candidate identity is unchanged.
Country-capable providers accept only verified actual exits; others do not imply country selection.
Existing R27 safety/at-rest/fail-closed behaviors remain regression-protected.
finalDecision: Adopt capability-driven provider UI and bounded source-diverse Node testing. Keep Browser Only default, explicit WARP-only Full System, and separate Console Gateway.
